scope: Reference comparison contract only; no capture/restore or server execution authorized
canonical_cells: CSFBASELINE1 NUL header; each ordered cell is N; for SQL NULL or V<byte length>:<lowercase hex>; for exact non-NULL bytes
sql_bytes: HEX(CAST(column AS BINARY)); session UTC; utf8mb4; preserve declared column order and separate physical schema descriptor
row_identity: SHA256 of framed table name and ordered PRIMARY KEY cells; reject missing/duplicate keys
row_value: SHA256 of framed ordered column bytes; no PHP unserialization, truthiness coercion, timestamp stripping or audit-field normalization
snapshot: All tables in one read-only consistent MVCC transaction; stable schema/index metadata checked before/after; SHA256 manifest/approved receipt binds complete private snapshot and source
private_evidence: Raw option names, per-row locators/digests and private lookups stay in restricted encrypted recovery artifacts; public report contains counts/categories and approved artifact hashes only
volatile_policy: Exact options-table labels only; candidates remain in raw diff and require acknowledgment. No cause inferred, automatic pass, wildcard transient omission or live write
other_options: Unclassified changes require private review; update caches/unknown transients are not silently ignored
other_tables: Changes require review; users, usermeta, scheduling, audit and source/schema changes are always critical
metadata: Capture time and row order are provenance, not business changes; retain raw timestamps/auto-increment observations separately without changing row cells or physical AUTO_INCREMENT column attributes
prohibited: LOCK TABLES or FLUSH TABLES WITH READ LOCK
